company.name: SharpestMinds
company.shortDescription: SharpestMinds connects undiscovered data science and machine learning talent with professional mentors to help them land their first role.
company.description:
SharpestMinds is a platform for early talent discovery in machine learning. It connects STEM graduate students and machine learning developers to businesses looking for AI talent.

The company aims to create a new kinds of machine learning-driven service that can identify tech talent early, get them in the door at startups, and eventually lead them to a potential hire for a problem they’re interested in.

productsAndServices.description: A service connecting individuals with professional mentors for personalized, one-on-one guidance in data science and machine learning career development.
productsAndServices.name: Mentorship Program

items.title: AI Isn't Magical and Won't Help You Reopen Your Business
SharpestMinds wants to help startups find AI talent before Google and Facebook snatch them
